## Helper functions

```{r}
simple_impute_for_viz <- function(mat) {
  out <- as.matrix(mat)
  global_floor <- suppressWarnings(stats::quantile(out, probs = 0.01, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(global_floor)) global_floor <- 0

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(out))) {
    miss <- is.na(out[i, ]) | !is.finite(out[i, ])
    if (!any(miss)) next

    obs <- out[i, !miss]

    if (length(obs) >= 3) {
      mu <- mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE)
      sdv <- stats::sd(obs, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (!is.finite(sdv) || sdv == 0) sdv <- 0.3
      out[i, miss] <- stats::rnorm(sum(miss), mean = mu - 1.8 * sdv, sd = max(0.05, 0.3 * sdv))
    } else {
      out[i, miss] <- global_floor
    }
  }

  out[!is.finite(out)] <- global_floor
  out
}

filter_pca_features <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  keep <- apply(mat, 1, function(x) {
    x <- x[is.finite(x)]
    length(x) >= 2 && stats::sd(x) > 0
  })
  mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}
```

## Import data

```{r read data}
ms_raw <- read.csv(here::here("data", "Mass_spec", "20260319_MS_DIA_report_2uniquepeptides.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read_excel(here::here("data", "OLINK", "Samples_RV_Olink.xlsx"))
meta22 <- read_excel("/home/gbonaz/data/DCM_snRNAseq/data/Baza_dla_Gino_AP.xlsx")

prot_annot <- ms_raw[, c("Protein.Group", "Protein.Names", "Genes", "First.Protein.Description",
                         "N.Sequences", "N.Proteotypic.Sequences")]

sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(ms_raw), colnames(prot_annot))
qc_cols <- grep("^QC", sample_cols, value = TRUE)
biol_cols <- setdiff(sample_cols, qc_cols)

expr0 <- as.data.frame(ms_raw[, biol_cols, drop = FALSE])
rownames(expr0) <- ms_raw$Genes

# remove proteins without gene symbol
keep_rows <- !is.na(rownames(expr0)) & rownames(expr0) != ""
expr0 <- expr0[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
prot_annot <- prot_annot[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# make unique rownames if needed
rownames(expr0) <- make.unique(rownames(expr0))
rownames(prot_annot) <- rownames(expr0)

# metadata for all 82 samples
meta <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr0)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

expr0 <- expr0[, meta$Sample, drop = FALSE]
dim(expr0)

# exclude PK211 globally
meta <- meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Sample %in% c("PK211", "P11"))

expr0 <- expr0[, colnames(expr0) %in% meta$Sample, drop = FALSE]
expr0 <- expr0[, meta$Sample, drop = FALSE]
dim(expr0)

# clinical metadata for all samples from the updated clinical file
meta22 <- meta22 %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("^Unnamed")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Sample %in% c("PK211", "P11")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    LVEF_percent = as.numeric(LVEF_percent),
    LVID_mm = as.numeric(LVID_mm),
    LVEDD_mm = as.numeric(LVEDD_mm),
    RVOT_mm = as.numeric(RVOT_mm),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm),
    RVIT_mm = as.numeric(RVIT_mm),
    RAA_cm2 = as.numeric(RAA_cm2),
    RVS_cm.s = as.numeric(RVS_cm.s),
    RVSP_mmHg = as.numeric(RVSP_mmHg),
    sPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(sPAP_mmHg),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    PCW_mmHg = as.numeric(PCW_mmHg),
    PVR_WU = as.numeric(PVR_WU),
    TPG_mmHg = as.numeric(TPG_mmHg),
    CO_l.min = as.numeric(CO_l.min),
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg
  )

# log2-transform
expr_log2 <- log2(as.matrix(expr0) + 1)
storage.mode(expr_log2) <- "numeric"

# visualization-only imputation for PCA / heatmaps
expr_log2_viz <- simple_impute_for_viz(expr_log2)

# keep annotation aligned
prot_annot <- prot_annot[rownames(expr_log2), , drop = FALSE]
```

## QC

```{r}
qc_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(expr_log2),
  Group = meta$Group[match(colnames(expr_log2), meta$Sample)],
  Batch = meta$Batch[match(colnames(expr_log2), meta$Sample)],
  Missing_fraction = colMeans(is.na(expr_log2)),
  Detected_proteins = colSums(!is.na(expr_log2)),
  Median_log2_abundance = colMedians(expr_log2, na.rm = TRUE)
)

qc_df %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(Missing_fraction))
```

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = reorder(Sample, Missing_fraction), y = Missing_fraction, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("HC" = "#004C8C", "DCM" = "#A63A2A")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction missing") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6))
```


## Heatmaps, PCA

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10.8}
barcodes <- colnames(expr_log2)

grp <- meta$Group[match(barcodes, meta$Sample)]
btc <- meta$Batch[match(barcodes, meta$Sample)]
btc <- factor(btc)

cols_group <- c("HC" = "#004C8C", "DCM" = "#A63A2A")
cols_batch <- setNames(c("orange", "purple", "darkgreen", "brown")[seq_along(levels(btc))], levels(btc))

matz <- t(scale(t(expr_log2_viz)))
matz[is.nan(matz)] <- 0
matz[is.na(matz)] <- 0

hm_cols <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = grp,
  Batch = btc,
  col = list(
    Group = cols_group,
    Batch = cols_batch
  ),
  na_col = "#E5E7EB",
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group"),
    Batch = list(title = "Batch")
  )
)

Heatmap(
  matz,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = hm_cols,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  row_title = NULL,
  column_title = NULL
) |>
  draw(heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")
```

```{r heatmap_top100var, fig.height=10.8, fig.width=10.8}

top100 <- names(sort(vars, decreasing = TRUE))[1:100]
mat_top <- expr_log2_viz[top100, , drop = FALSE]

matz <- t(scale(t(mat_top)))
matz[is.nan(matz)] <- 0
matz[is.na(matz)] <- 0

Heatmap(
  matz,
  name = "Z-score",

  show_row_names = TRUE,

) |>

```

```{r, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=5.4}
expr_log2_pca <- filter_pca_features(expr_log2_viz)

pvar <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100

df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  Group = meta$Group[match(rownames(pca$x), meta$Sample)]
)

ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Group)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Group), type = "norm", level = 0.95,
               geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10, color = NA) +
  stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_group) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_group) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pvar[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pvar[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Variance partitioning

```{r vp_all, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6.5}
expr <- as.matrix(expr_log2)

meta_p <- meta |>
  dplyr::left_join(meta22 %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Sex), by = "Sample") |>
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[rowSums(is.na(expr) | !is.finite(expr)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]

vars <- c("Group", "Batch", "Sex")
meta_p <- meta_p |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group),
    Batch = factor(Batch),
    Sex = factor(Sex)
  )

meta_p <- meta_p[complete.cases(meta_p[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

form <- ~ Group + Batch + Sex

vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta_p)
colnames(vp) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(vp))

vp_mean <- sort(colMeans(vp), decreasing = TRUE)
df <- data.frame(variable = names(vp_mean), value = vp_mean)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(variable, -value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction of variance explained",
       title = "All samples") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r vp_22, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=6.5}
expr <- as.matrix(expr_22_analysis)

meta_p <- meta22_dcm |>
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr)) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[rowSums(is.na(expr) | !is.finite(expr)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]

vars <- c("mPAP_mmHg", "Age_years", "Sex")
meta_p <- meta_p[complete.cases(meta_p[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]
expr <- expr[, rownames(meta_p), drop = FALSE]

meta_p <- meta_p |>
  dplyr::mutate(Sex = factor(Sex))

form <- ~ mPAP_mmHg + Age_years + Sex

vp <- fitExtractVarPartModel(expr, form, meta_p)
colnames(vp) <- gsub("`", "", colnames(vp))

vp_mean <- sort(colMeans(vp), decreasing = TRUE)
df <- data.frame(variable = names(vp_mean), value = vp_mean)

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(variable, -value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean fraction of variance explained",
       title = "DCM cohort after exclusion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## DCM vs HC

```{r}
meta_all <- meta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta22 %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Sex), by = "Sample") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_log2)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Group = factor(Group),
    Sex = factor(Sex)
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

meta_all <- meta_all[complete.cases(meta_all[, c("Group", "Sex")]), , drop = FALSE]
expr_all <- expr_log2[, rownames(meta_all), drop = FALSE]

# keep proteins detected in >=70% of samples in at least one group
idx_list <- split(seq_len(ncol(expr_all)), meta_all$Group)
det_rate <- sapply(idx_list, function(idx) rowMeans(!is.na(expr_all[, idx, drop = FALSE])))
keep_prot <- apply(det_rate, 1, function(x) any(x >= 0.70))
expr_all_filt <- expr_all[keep_prot, , drop = FALSE]
dim(expr_all_filt)
```

```{r DE_DCM_vs_HC}
design <- model.matrix(~ Group + Sex, data = meta_all)

fit <- lmFit(expr_all_filt, design, na.action = na.exclude)
fit <- eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

res_all_ms <- topTable(fit, coef = grep("^Group", colnames(design))[1], number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
res_all_ms$feature <- rownames(res_all_ms)
res_all_ms <- merge(res_all_ms, prot_annot[, c("Protein.Names", "Protein.Group")], by.x = "feature", by.y = 0, all.x = TRUE)
res_all_ms$up_down <- ifelse(
  res_all_ms$logFC > 0.5 & res_all_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1, "Increased",
  ifelse(res_all_ms$logFC < -0.5 & res_all_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1, "Decreased", "Not significant")
)

signif_all_ms <- res_all_ms %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val)

write.csv(res_all_ms, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_DCM_vs_HC_MS.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(signif_all_ms, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_DCM_vs_HC_MS.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r volcano_DCM_vs_HC, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5.5}
keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(res_all_ms))
names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(res_all_ms))
keyvals[res_all_ms$logFC > 0.5 & res_all_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
keyvals[res_all_ms$logFC < -0.5 & res_all_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"

EnhancedVolcano(
  res_all_ms,
  lab = res_all_ms$feature,
  x = "logFC",
  y = "adj.P.Val",
  labSize = 0,
  titleLabSize = 16,
  subtitleLabSize = 14,
  axisLabSize = 12,
  captionLabSize = 9,
  pointSize = 0.8,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pCutoff = 0.1,
  ylim = c(0, max(3, ceiling(max(-log10(res_all_ms$adj.P.Val), na.rm = TRUE)))) ,
  colCustom = keyvals,
  colAlpha = 1,
  drawConnectors = FALSE,
  subtitle = NULL,
  title = paste0("DCM vs HC\n", "n = ", ncol(expr_all_filt))
) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r DE_mPAP}
sample_order <- colnames(expr_mpap_filt)

)
```

```{r heatmap_mpap_top, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
n_top <- 50

top_up <- res_mpap_ms %>%

  dplyr::arrange(desc(t)) %>%

)
```

## Clinical parameters in the DCM cohort

```{r}
meta_clin <- meta22_dcm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg
  )

expr_all <- expr_22_analysis[, colnames(expr_22_analysis) %in% meta_clin$Sample, drop = FALSE]

meta_clin <- meta_clin %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_all)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr_all <- expr_all[, rownames(meta_clin), drop = FALSE]

clin_params <- c(
  "LVEF_percent", "LVID_mm", "LVEDD_mm", "RVOT_mm",
  "TAPSE_mm", "RVIT_mm", "RAA_cm2", "RVS_cm.s",
  "RVSP_mmHg", "sPAP_mmHg", "mPAP_mmHg",
  "PCW_mmHg", "PVR_WU", "TPG_mmHg", "CO_l.min",
  "TAPSE_sPAP"
)

DE_results_list_ms <- list()
DE_signif_list_ms <- list()
volcano_ms <- list()
heatmap_ms <- list()
n_de_proteins_ms <- data.frame()
```

```{r}
for (param in clin_params) {

  vars <- c(param, "Age_years", "Sex")

  meta_de <- meta_clin
  meta_de <- meta_de[complete.cases(meta_de[, vars]), , drop = FALSE]

  expr_de0 <- expr_all[, rownames(meta_de), drop = FALSE]

  keep_prot <- rowMeans(!is.na(expr_de0)) >= 0.70
  expr_de <- expr_de0[keep_prot, , drop = FALSE]

  design <- model.matrix(
    stats::as.formula(paste0("~ ", param, " + Age_years + Sex")),
    data = meta_de
  )

  design[, param] <- scales::rescale(design[, param])
  design[, "Age_years"] <- scales::rescale(design[, "Age_years"])

  fit <- lmFit(expr_de, design, na.action = na.exclude)
  fit <- eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE)

  coef_name <- grep(paste0("^", param, "$"), colnames(design), value = TRUE)[1]

  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
  tt$feature <- rownames(tt)
  tt$parameter <- param
  tt$n_complete_samples <- nrow(meta_de)
  tt$n_tested_proteins <- nrow(expr_de)

  tt_signif <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(P.Value)

  DE_results_list_ms[[param]] <- tt
  DE_signif_list_ms[[param]] <- tt_signif

  write.csv(tt,
            file = file.path(output_dir_data, paste0("DE_Results_", param, "_MS.csv")),
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(tt_signif,
            file = file.path(output_dir_data, paste0("DE_Significant_", param, "_MS.csv")),
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

  n_de_proteins_temp <- data.frame(
    metadata = param,
    n_upregulated = sum(DE_signif_list_ms[[param]]$logFC > 0.5),
    n_downregulated = sum(DE_signif_list_ms[[param]]$logFC < -0.5),
    n_tot = nrow(DE_signif_list_ms[[param]]),
    n_complete_samples = nrow(meta_de),
    n_tested_proteins = nrow(expr_de)
  )
  n_de_proteins_ms <- rbind(n_de_proteins_ms, n_de_proteins_temp)

  keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(DE_results_list_ms[[param]]))
  names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(DE_results_list_ms[[param]]))
  keyvals[DE_results_list_ms[[param]]$logFC > 0.5 & DE_results_list_ms[[param]]$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
  keyvals[DE_results_list_ms[[param]]$logFC < -0.5 & DE_results_list_ms[[param]]$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"

  volcano_ms[[param]] <- EnhancedVolcano(
    DE_results_list_ms[[param]],
    lab = DE_results_list_ms[[param]]$feature,
    x = "logFC",
    y = "adj.P.Val",
    labSize = 0,
    titleLabSize = 16,
    subtitleLabSize = 14,
    axisLabSize = 12,
    captionLabSize = 9,
    pointSize = 0.5,
    FCcutoff = 0.5,
    pCutoff = 0.1,
    ylim = c(0, 3),
    colCustom = keyvals,
    colAlpha = 1,
    drawConnectors = FALSE,
    subtitle = NULL,
    title = paste0(param, "\nn = ", nrow(meta_de))
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none")

  n_top <- 50

  top_up <- DE_results_list_ms[[param]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(logFC > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(t)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n_top)

  top_down <- DE_results_list_ms[[param]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(logFC < 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(t) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n_top)

  row_order_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    top_up %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(t)),
    top_down %>% dplyr::arrange(t)
  )

  meta_ord <- meta_de %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[param]])

  mat <- expr_de[row_order_tbl$feature, meta_ord$Sample, drop = FALSE]
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  mat_z[is.na(mat_z)] <- 0
  rownames(mat_z) <- row_order_tbl$feature

  ha_heat <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    value = meta_ord[[param]],
    Age = meta_ord$Age_years,
    Sex = meta_ord$Sex,
    col = list(
      value = colorRamp2(
        c(min(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE),
          median(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE),
          max(meta_ord[[param]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("#DCEAF7", "#6AAED6", "#08306B")
      ),
      Age = colorRamp2(
        c(min(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
          median(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
          max(meta_ord$Age_years, na.rm = TRUE)),
        c("grey90", "grey60", "grey20")
      ),
      Sex = c("F" = "#E78AC3", "M" = "#4EB3D3")
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
  )

  row_split <- c(
    rep(paste0("Positive association with ", param), nrow(top_up)),
    rep(paste0("Negative association with ", param), nrow(top_down))
  )

  heatmap_ms[[param]] <- Heatmap(
    mat_z,
    name = "Z-score",
    col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
    top_annotation = ha_heat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_split = row_split,
    show_row_dend = FALSE,
    show_column_dend = FALSE,
    column_title = paste0("Patients ordered by increasing ", param),
    row_title = "Proteins ranked by limma moderated t-statistic",
    column_names_rot = 45,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7)
  )
}
```

```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width=24, dpi=300}
print(
  (volcano_ms[[1]]  | volcano_ms[[2]]  | volcano_ms[[3]]  | volcano_ms[[4]] |

)
```

## Binary clinical comparisons

```{r}
meta_bin <- meta22_dcm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age_years = as.numeric(Age_years),
    mPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(mPAP_mmHg),
    TAPSE_mm = as.numeric(TAPSE_mm),
    sPAP_mmHg = as.numeric(sPAP_mmHg),
    TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm / sPAP_mmHg,
    mPAP_group = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(mPAP_mmHg) & mPAP_mmHg > 35  ~ "mPAP_hi",
      !is.na(mPAP_mmHg) & mPAP_mmHg <= 35 ~ "mPAP_lo",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TAPSE_sPAP_group = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(TAPSE_sPAP) & TAPSE_sPAP < 0.32  ~ "TAPSE_sPAP_low",
      !is.na(TAPSE_sPAP) & TAPSE_sPAP >= 0.32 ~ "TAPSE_sPAP_high",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

expr_bin <- expr_22_analysis[, colnames(expr_22_analysis) %in% meta_bin$Sample, drop = FALSE]

meta_bin <- meta_bin %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% colnames(expr_bin)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Sample")

expr_bin <- expr_bin[, rownames(meta_bin), drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}

names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(res_mPAP_group_ms))
keyvals[res_mPAP_group_ms$logFC > 0.5 & res_mPAP_group_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#A63A2A"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
keyvals[res_mPAP_group_ms$logFC < -0.5 & res_mPAP_group_ms$adj.P.Val < 0.1] <- "#004C8C"
names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"

volcano_mPAP_group_ms <- EnhancedVolcano(

  y = "adj.P.Val",

  axisLabSize = 12,
  captionLabSize = 9,
  pointSize = 0.5,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pCutoff = 0.1,
  ylim = c(0, 3),
  colCustom = keyvals,
  colAlpha = 1,
  drawConnectors = FALSE,
  subtitle = NULL,
  title = paste0(
    "mPAP > 35 vs <= 35\n",
    "n = ", nrow(meta_de),
    " (", sum(meta_de$mPAP_group == "mPAP_hi"), " hi / ",
    sum(meta_de$mPAP_group == "mPAP_lo"), " lo)"
  )
) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
  y = "adj.P.Val",
  labSize = 0,
  titleLabSize = 16,
  subtitleLabSize = 14,
  axisLabSize = 12,
  captionLabSize = 9,
  pointSize = 0.5,
  FCcutoff = 0.5,
  pCutoff = 0.1,
  ylim = c(0, 3),
  colCustom = keyvals,
  colAlpha = 1,
  drawConnectors = FALSE,
  subtitle = NULL,
  title = paste0(
    "TAPSE/sPAP < 0.32 vs >= 0.32\n",
    "n = ", nrow(meta_de),
    " (", sum(meta_de$TAPSE_sPAP_group == "TAPSE_sPAP_low"), " low / ",
    sum(meta_de$TAPSE_sPAP_group == "TAPSE_sPAP_high"), " high)"
  )
) + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## snRNAseq

```{r Load data, echo = TRUE, results= "hide"}
DCM_RV <- qs_read(here::here("output", "QC_integration_annotation", "DCM_RV_RNA.qs2"), nthreads = 32)
DefaultAssay(DCM_RV) <- "RNA"
Idents(DCM_RV) <- "cell_type"
DCM_RV$pseudobulk <- "pseudobulk"
```

```{r}
data_sn <- subset(DCM_RV, mPAP_mmHg > 0 & Sample %in% meta22_dcm$Sample)

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data_sn, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells / total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)
```

```{r}
pseudocounts_mPAP <- Seurat2PB(data_sn, sample = "Sample", cluster = "pseudobulk")
colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP) <- pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$sample
keep_genes <- intersect(res_mpap_ms$feature, rownames(pseudocounts_mPAP))
pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[keep_genes, ]
dim(pseudocounts_mPAP)
keep_samples <- pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$lib.size > 5e4
pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[, keep_samples]
```

```{r DE_mPAP_snRNA}
sample_order <- colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP)

metadata_mPAP <- meta22_dcm %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample %in% sample_order) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(sample_order, Sample)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mPAP_mmHg), !is.na(Age_years))

pseudocounts_mPAP <- pseudocounts_mPAP[, metadata_mPAP$Sample]
sample_order <- colnames(pseudocounts_mPAP)
stopifnot(all(metadata_mPAP$Sample == sample_order))

design <- model.matrix(~ metadata_mPAP[["mPAP_mmHg"]] + metadata_mPAP[["Age_years"]])
colnames(design)[2] <- "mPAP_mmHg"
colnames(design)[3] <- "Age_years"
design[, "mPAP_mmHg"] <- rescale(design[, "mPAP_mmHg"])

metadata_mPAP$Sample == pseudocounts_mPAP$samples$sample

pseudocounts_mPAP <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_mPAP)
pseudocounts_mPAP <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_mPAP, design)

fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_mPAP, design, robust = TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)

results_mPAP_ms <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
results_mPAP_ms <- merge(results_mPAP_ms, percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
results_mPAP_ms$up_down <- ifelse(
  results_mPAP_ms$logFC > 0.5 & results_mPAP_ms$FDR < 0.1, "Increased",
  ifelse(results_mPAP_ms$logFC < -0.5 & results_mPAP_ms$FDR < 0.1, "Decreased", "Not significant")
)

signif_mPAP_ms <- results_mPAP_ms %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(FDR)

write.csv(results_mPAP_ms, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Results_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(signif_mPAP_ms, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Signif_DE_pseudobulk_allcells_mPAP.csv"), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r cor_mpap_logfc, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5.5}
df <- dplyr::inner_join(
  results_mPAP_ms %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(Gene = gene, logFC_results = logFC),
  res_mpap_ms %>% dplyr::select(feature, logFC) %>% dplyr::rename(logFC_DE = logFC, Gene = feature),
  by = "Gene"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(logFC_results), is.finite(logFC_DE))

ct <- cor.test(df$logFC_results, df$logFC_DE, method = "pearson")

r_val <- round(unname(ct$estimate), 2)
p_val <- signif(ct$p.value, 2)

ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_results, y = logFC_DE)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("r = ", r_val, "\np = ", p_val, "\nn = ", nrow(df)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "logFC (results_mPAP_ms)",
    y = "logFC (res_mpap_ms)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r reorder_GO_by_pvalue}
reorder_GO_by_pvalue <- function(enrichGO_result) {
  go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
  go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(go_results$p.adjust), ]
  enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
  return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r classify_terms}
classify_terms <- function(df) {
  df$sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
ranked_genes <- res_TAPSEsPAP_group_ms
ranked_genes$metric <- ranked_genes$logFC* -log10(ranked_genes$P.Value)
entrezid <- bitr(ranked_genes$feature, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db", drop = TRUE)
ranked_genes <- merge(ranked_genes, entrezid, by.x = "feature", by.y = "SYMBOL")
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!duplicated(ranked_genes$metric), ]

genelist <- ranked_genes$metric
names(genelist) <- ranked_genes$ENTREZID
genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = T)]

GSEA_all <- gseGO(geneList = genelist,
                     OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                     ont = "ALL",
                     keyType = "ENTREZID",
                     nPermSimple = 10000,
                     minGSSize = 10,
                  pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     eps = 0)
GSEA_all <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_all)

```

```{r GSEA_Cardiomyocytes, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
GSEA_simplified <- clusterProfiler::simplify(
  GSEA_all,
  cutoff = 0.75,
  by = "p.adjust",
  select_fun = min,
  measure = "Wang",
  semData = NULL
)

GSEA_simplified <- reorder_GO_by_pvalue(GSEA_simplified)

dotplot(GSEA_simplified, showCategory = 8, split=".sign", title = paste0("Cardiomyocytes", "\nGO Enrichment Analysis", "\nmPAP-associated genes"), 
        label_format = 35, font.size = 15) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text( face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)) +
  facet_grid(.~.sign)
```

```{r GSEA_Cardiomyocytes_emapplot, fig.height=10, fig.width=20}
GSEA_simplified@result <- classify_terms(GSEA_simplified@result)

activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "activated")
suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_simplified@result, sign == "suppressed")

GSEA_activated <- GSEA_simplified
GSEA_activated@result <- activated_terms
GSEA_activated <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_activated)

GSEA_suppressed <- GSEA_simplified
GSEA_suppressed@result <- suppressed_terms
GSEA_suppressed <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_suppressed)

p1 <- emapplot(GSEA_activated, showCategory = 100, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.15) +
  ggtitle("Activated Terms") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

p2 <- emapplot(GSEA_suppressed, showCategory = 100, size_category = 0.7, min_edge = 0.15) +
  ggtitle("Suppressed Terms") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

combined_plot <- p1 | p2
print(combined_plot)
rm(GSEA_simplified, activated_terms, suppressed_terms, GSEA_activated, GSEA_suppressed, p1, p2)
```
